#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unpack quarterly_report.docx using only the standard library.

Extracts the zip into unpacked/ and writes a pretty-printed copy of
word/document.xml (and styles.xml) into preview/ for inspection.
"""
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from xml.dom import minidom

SRC = "quarterly_report.docx"
OUT = Path("unpacked")
PREVIEW = Path("preview")

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zf:
    zf.extractall(OUT)

# Pretty-print XML copies for inspection (originals kept raw for editing)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Underline all headlines in unpacked/word/document.xml (standard library only).

Headlines in this report are paragraphs whose alphabetic content is entirely
uppercase (e.g., "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY", "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK"). For each headline
paragraph, add <w:u w:val="single"/> to every run's w:rPr and to the
paragraph-mark w:rPr, at the schema-correct position.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from xml.dom import minidom

XML_PATH = Path("unpacked/word/document.xml")

# CT_RPr / CT_ParaRPr child order (local names) per ECMA-376; "u" is at index 26
RPR_ORDER = [
    "rStyle", "rFonts", "b", "bCs", "i", "iCs", "caps", "smallCaps",
    "strike", "dstrike", "outline", "shadow", "emboss", "imprint",
    "noProof", "snapToGrid", "vanish", "webHidden", "color", "spacing",
    "w", "kern", "position", "sz", "szCs", "highlight", "u", "effect",
    "bdr", "shd", "fitText", "vertAlign", "rtl", "cs", "em", "lang",
    "eastAsianLayout", "specVanish", "oMath",
]


def ensure_underline(rpr):
    """Ensure rPr contains <w:u w:val="single"/> at the correct position."""
    u_elems = rpr.getElementsByTagName("w:u")
    if u_elems:
        u_elems[0].setAttribute("w:val", "single")
        return
    u = rpr.ownerDocument.createElement("w:u")
    u.setAttribute("w:val", "single")
    u_order = RPR_ORDER.index("u")
    insert_before = None
    for child in rpr.childNodes:
        if child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE:
            name = child.tagName.split(":")[-1]
            if name in RPR_ORDER and RPR_ORDER.index(name) > u_order:
                insert_before = child
                break
    rpr.insertBefore(u, insert_before)


def paragraph_text(p):
    return "".join(
        t.firstChild.data for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t")
        if t.firstChild
    )


def is_headline(p):
    letters = [c for c in paragraph_text(p) if c.isalpha()]
    return bool(letters) and all(c.isupper() for c in letters)


dom = minidom.parse(str(XML_PATH))
headlines = []
for p in dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p"):
    if not is_headline(p):
        continue
    headlines.append(paragraph_text(p).strip())

    # Underline each run
    for r in p.getElementsByTagName("w:r"):
        rprs = r.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
        if rprs:
            rpr = rprs[0]
        else:
            rpr = dom.createElement("w:rPr")
            r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
        ensure_underline(rpr)

    # Underline the paragraph mark
    pprs = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pPr")
    if pprs:
        ppr = pprs[0]
        rprs = ppr.getElementsByTagName("w:rPr")
        if rprs:
            prpr = rprs[0]
        else:
            prpr = dom.createElement("w:rPr")
            ppr.appendChild(prpr)
        ensure_underline(prpr)

with open(XML_PATH, "wb") as f:
    f.write(dom.toxml(encoding="UTF-8"))

print(f"Underlined {len(headlines)} headlines:")
for h in headlines:
    print("  -", h)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify underlined headlines in unpacked/word/document.xml."""
from pathlib import Path
from xml.dom import minidom

XML_PATH = Path("unpacked/word/document.xml")
dom = minidom.parse(str(XML_PATH))
paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")

headline_texts = []
body_with_underline = []
total_u = 0

for p in paras:
    text = "".join(
        t.firstChild.data for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t") if t.firstChild
    ).strip()
    u_in_runs = p.getElementsByTagName("w:u")
    total_u += len(u_in_runs)
    letters = [c for c in text if c.isalpha()]
    is_headline = bool(letters) and all(c.isupper() for c in letters)
    if is_headline:
        headline_texts.append(text)
        assert u_in_runs, f"Headline missing underline: {text}"
    elif text and u_in_runs:
        body_with_underline.append(text)

print(f"Paragraphs with <w:u>: {total_u}")
print(f"Headlines verified underlined ({len(headline_texts)}):")
for h in headline_texts:
    print("  -", h)
assert body_with_underline == [], f"Unexpected underline in body: {body_with_underline}"
print("No non-headline paragraph contains an underline. VERIFIED OK")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pack unpacked/ back into quarterly_report.docx (standard library only).

Condenses XML whitespace (mimicking ooxml pack.py), writes the zip to a temp
file, then atomically replaces quarterly_report.docx. Finally re-opens the
packed docx and validates that every XML part is well-formed.
"""
import os
import tempfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from xml.dom import minidom

SRC_DIR = Path("unpacked")
OUT = Path("quarterly_report.docx")

TEXT_BEARING_LOCAL = {"t", "delText", "instrText", "delInstrText", "tab", "br",
                      "cr", "noBreakHyphen", "softHyphen"}


def condense_xml(path):
    dom = minidom.parse(str(path))
    for element in dom.getElementsByTagName("*"):
        local = element.tagName.split(":")[-1]
        if local in TEXT_BEARING_LOCAL:
            continue
        for child in list(element.childNodes):
            if child.nodeType == child.TEXT_NODE and child.nodeValue.strip() == "":
                element.removeChild(child)
            elif child.nodeType == child.COMMENT_NODE:
                element.removeChild(child)
    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(dom.toxml(encoding="UTF-8"))


with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    tmp_dir = Path(tmp)
    for pattern in ("*.xml", "*.rels"):
        for xml_file in SRC_DIR.rglob(pattern):
            condense_xml(xml_file)
    tmp_out = tmp_dir / "packed.docx"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_out, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for f in sorted(SRC_DIR.rglob("*")):
            if f.is_file():
                zf.write(f, f.relative_to(SRC_DIR).as_posix())
    os.replace(tmp_out, OUT)

# Validate: reopen and parse every XML part
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT) as zf:
    names = zf.namelist()
    for name in names:
        if name.endswith((".xml", ".rels")):
            minidom.parseString(zf.read(name))
    doc = minidom.parseString(zf.read("word/document.xml"))
    wu = doc.getElementsByTagName("w:u")
    print(f"Packed {len(names)} parts -> {OUT}")
    print(f"document.xml parses OK; contains {len(wu)} <w:u> elements")
print("PACKED AND VALIDATED OK")
